description:
Returns the Neblla developer guide as text, split by section (the response lists them in `sections`). `empezar` describes when Neblla fits an app and what it connects to. `core` (the default) is the canonical six-file layout, the events-only client/server contract and the app shapes. The other sections match the neblla.* modules: salas (rooms, lobby, matchmaking), servidor (the 3 server modes, state.set, anti-cheat), identidad (login/SSO/scopes/save), social (friends + dev↔user communications), comunidad (user-published entries: neblla.community, moderation), pagos (products/Stripe), ia (neblla.ai routes), publicar (gallery + quota table), referencia (the full API/events tables), mcp (this server's tools + creation flow), index (the table of contents), full (everything at once).

With an `appId` the guide comes cut to the app's neblla.* modules — only the chapters and sections of the modules it has, and `modules` says which.

Section `access` (needs the token, as the app's owner or one of its team) with the `appId` lists, for each role of the app (its users, neblla.db on a group's rows) and each group of its team (the panel and this MCP), what works and what answers `not_allowed`, made from the same tables the server applies; `role` or `group` gives only that one. A member of the app's team (not its owner) gets their own, and the `mcp` chapter cut to the tools their groups allow.

Each response lists the available `sections`. Most sections fit in one response; for long ones `hasMore` is true and `nextOffset` is the `offset` of the next chunk.

The tool list was built at Neblla build 36; each response carries the live `latestBuild`. A higher `latestBuild` means the server was redeployed after the connection, so the loaded tool list may be out of date until the client reconnects.

appId.description: An app's id: the guide cut to that app's modules (chapters and sections of modules it does not have are left out).

group.description: With section "access": only this group of the team

lang.description: Language. The guide is written in Spanish and most chapters are also translated. "en" serves the English version of a section when one exists and falls back to the Spanish original otherwise, saying which in `langNote` (see `langNote`).

maxLength.description: Maximum length of `guide` to return in this chunk. The default stays under the response-size limit of MCP clients.

offset.description: Character position to start reading from. 0 = start. Pass the previous response's `nextOffset` for the next chunk.

role.description: With section "access": only this role of the app

section.description: Which part of the guide to read. Default "core"; "empezar" says when Neblla fits an app. "index" = table of contents, "full" = the whole guide. "access" (with appId) = what each role and team group of that app can use.
